title_on_screen: BRIGHT SIDE HAS COLLECTED THE MOST BASIC RULES THAT WILL HELP YOU TO LOOK PERFECT ALL THE TIME.
promise: The video presents basic style and dress code rules to help viewers look polished and perfect all the time.

points.name: JACKET
points.exact_words: THE MIDDLE BUTTON ON A JACKET SHOULD ALWAYS BE CLOSED. THE UPPER ONE DEPENDS ON YOUR MOOD. THE LOWER ONE SHOULD NEVER BE CLOSED.
points.why_given: Proper button etiquette maintains the intended silhouette and formality of a jacket.
points.how_shown: 2D animation of a man in a navy suit showing button rules labeled with ALWAYS, SOMETIMES, and NEVER.
points.example_pieces: Navy suit jacket, white shirt, red tie

points.name: A SHIRT OR A BLOUSE
points.exact_words: WHEN YOU ARE WEARING A SHIRT OR A BLOUSE, YOU CAN UNBUTTON NO MORE THAN 2 BUTTONS.
points.why_given: Unbuttoning more than two buttons looks overly revealing and inappropriate for casual/formal wear.
points.how_shown: Animation comparing a woman with too many buttons unbuttoned (red X) vs. two buttons unbuttoned (green checkmark).

points.name: BIJOUTERIE
points.exact_words: WEAR EARRINGS THAT MATCH YOUR BRACELET AND A NECKLACE THAT GOES WELL WITH YOUR RING. 3 OR 4 THINGS IN ONE LOOK IS TOO MUCH.
points.why_given: Wearing too many matching jewelry pieces creates an overcrowded look.
points.how_shown: Animation comparing a woman wearing full set jewelry (red X) vs. paired sets (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Purple gemstone earrings, necklace, bracelet, ring, brown sweater

points.name: TIE
points.exact_words: THE TIP OF YOUR TIE SHOULD REACH YOUR WAIST AND CROSS IT JUST A LITTLE.
points.why_given: A tie that is too short or too long looks ill-fitted.
points.how_shown: Animation comparing short tie (red X), long tie (red X), and proper length tie reaching the belt line (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Blue striped tie, white dress shirt, brown leather belt

points.name: DRESS
points.exact_words: OPT FOR EITHER A MINISKIRT OR CLEAVAGE. BOTH AT ONCE LOOK TOO VULGAR.
points.why_given: Combining a short hemline with deep cleavage looks tacky and vulgar.
points.how_shown: Animation showing short dress with low cut (red X), long gown with cleavage (green checkmark), and high-neck short dress (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Black mini dress, red evening gown

points.name: SHIRT
points.exact_words: IF YOU ARE WEARING A SHIRT WITHOUT A JACKET, YOU DON'T NEED A TIE.
points.why_given: A tie worn with just a shirt without a jacket looks incomplete.
points.how_shown: Animation comparing a shirt with tie and no jacket (red X) against a shirt without a tie (green checkmark).

points.name: SHIRT
points.exact_words: YOUR OFFICE SHIRT CLEAVAGE SHOULD NOT BE DEEPER THAN 4" FROM YOUR COLLARBONE.
points.why_given: Excessive cleavage is inappropriate for an office environment.
points.how_shown: Animation measuring neckline distance greater than 4 inches (red X) vs. less than 4 inches (green checkmark).

points.name: BELT
points.exact_words: IF YOU TUCKED IN YOUR SHIRT, YOU SHOULD WEAR A BELT.
points.why_given: A tucked-in shirt without a belt leaves the waistband looking bare and incomplete.
points.how_shown: Animation comparing tucked shirt with no belt (red X) vs. tucked shirt with belt (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: White button-down shirt, navy trousers, brown belt

points.name: CARDIGAN
points.exact_words: YOUR NAKED SKIN SHOULD NOT BE SEEN BETWEEN YOUR CARDIGAN AND YOUR JEANS. WEAR A TOP IF NECESSARY.
points.why_given: Exposing bare waist skin between a cardigan and pants looks messy.
points.how_shown: Animation showing midriff exposure (red X) vs. wearing a layer underneath to cover skin (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Red buttoned cardigan, blue jeans, black undershirt

points.name: BELT
points.exact_words: YOUR BELT SHOULD BE THE SAME COLOR AS YOUR SHOES.
points.why_given: Matching leather accessories creates a cohesive outfit.
points.how_shown: Animation showing brown belt with black shoes (red X) vs. black belt with black shoes (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Grey suit trousers, black shoes, brown and black belts

points.name: TAGS ON CLOTHES
points.exact_words: ALL VISIBLE TAGS ON CLOTHES SHOULD BE CUT OFF.
points.why_given: Visible exterior tags look untidy and unpolished.
points.how_shown: Animation showing a visible tag on a jacket sleeve (red X) vs. tag removed (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Suit jacket sleeve with manufacturer tag

points.name: PRINTS
points.exact_words: DON'T WEAR TOO MANY PRINTS. YOU CAN WEAR 2 DIFFERENT PRINTS OF THE SAME COLOR OR 2 COORDINATING PRINTS OF DIFFERENT SIZES.
points.why_given: Mixing conflicting patterns without shared color/scale creates visual chaos.
points.how_shown: Animation showing clashing pattern combination (red X) vs. matching color scheme patterns (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Blue striped blouse, pink floral skirt, light blue floral skirt

points.name: BLOUSE
points.exact_words: AN OFFICE BLOUSE WITHOUT SLEEVES SHOULD COVER YOUR SHOULDERS. "SPAGHETTI" STRAPS ARE NOT OKAY IN FORMAL SITUATIONS.
points.why_given: Spaghetti straps are too casual and informal for professional settings.
points.how_shown: Animation showing thin camisole straps (red X) vs. sleeveless blouse covering shoulders (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: White camisole top, blue sleeveless collar blouse

points.name: SOCKS
points.exact_words: YOUR SOCKS SHOULD BE LONG ENOUGH THAT YOUR NAKED LEGS AREN'T SEEN WHEN YOU ARE SITTING.
points.why_given: Exposing bare leg skin when seated in formal trousers looks unsuited for business attire.
points.how_shown: Animation showing seated man with short socks exposing leg skin (red X) vs. tall socks covering skin (green checkmark).
points.example_pieces: Suit trousers, dress socks, dress shoes

structure_notes: The video uses animated illustrations set to upbeat background music without narration. Each rule begins with a bold label indicating the garment or topic, followed by text explaining the rule and an animated comparison demonstrating correct vs. incorrect examples tagged with checkmark and cross icons.
visual_style: Bright solid color backgrounds alternating between yellow and light blue
On-screen text text overlays introducing and explaining each style tip
Green checkmark and red X icon graphics to evaluate outfits
